About Fubo:
FuboTV Inc. is a consumer-first live TV streaming company that is defining the future of TV.
Ranked among Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies (2026) and the Financial Times’ The Americas’ Fastest-Growing Companies (2026, 2025), FuboTV owns Hulu + Live TV (entertainment), Fubo (sports) and Molotov (entertainment and sports), which stream in markets around the globe.
Our Mission:
Our mission is to deliver premium sports, news and entertainment programming through a best-in-class user experience that offers greater choice, flexibility and value.
About the Role:
*This role is a New York City based HYBRID position. Candidates must be located in NYC, and willing to come into the office on a hybrid basis, three times a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday).*
Fubo is seeking an enthusiastic Software Engineer to join our Ads Engineering team. You'll help build and scale the backend infrastructure and services that power Fubo's advertising platform — no prior ad-tech experience required, we'll ramp you up on the domain.
As an engineer on this team, you'll work on business-critical distributed systems and data problems: services that interface with ad-decisioning systems, video player vendors, ad routers, and server-side ad insertion partners. You'll help increase the reliability and observability of this infrastructure and build tooling that lets our Advertising Operations and Sales teams move fast in a complex ecosystem. Over time, you'll become one of the team's go-to experts on our ad platform and the broader ad-tech landscape — but you don't need that background to start.
This is a great opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving backend, distributed-systems, and data engineering problems, and wants exposure to a fast-moving, high-scale domain.
What You'll Do:
Build and support our ads engineering infrastructure and services
Drive continuous improvements to the reliability, performance, accuracy, and security of services
Solve distributed systems engineering and data problems, utilizing the best tools and technologies
Build shared libraries, tools, or frameworks that improve engineering solutions
Implement unit and integrations tests to maintain confidence in the platform's stability
Identify and execute on opportunities to develop software to help increase efficiency, visibility, and performance of our ad technology
Extract and aggregate data from a variety of sources into data warehouses
Leverage AI tools across the development lifecycle — coding, testing, debugging, and documentation — to move faster without lowering our quality bar

Ideal Qualifications and Experience:
